full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave raised its exit 2026 annualized run-rate revenue (ARR) target to $18 billion to $19 billion. The company also increased its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $31 billion to $35 billion to support accelerating customer demand and AI infrastructure.
full_event_log.Event Title: CoreWeave increases 2026 ARR target and capex forecast

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave targets Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of $7–9 billion by year-end 2026, with analysts forecasting a revenue surge of 355% to 600% in 2026 as pivotal contracts commence.
full_event_log.Event Title: Revenue surge and ARR target achievement

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave projects that two-thirds of its Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) by the end of 2026 will come from Microsoft, OpenAI, and Meta combined. This indicates significant concentration of revenue from major technology companies.
full_event_log.Event Title: Two-thirds of ARR projected from Microsoft, OpenAI, and Meta by end-2026

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave expects each of its software, CPU and networking business segments to exceed $100 million in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) by the end of 2026. The company highlighted that customers are leveraging these products for innovation purposes.
full_event_log.Event Title: Software, CPU and networking businesses expected to exceed $100M ARR by end of year

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave targets Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of $7–9 billion by year-end 2026, with analysts forecasting a revenue surge of 355% to 600% in 2026 as pivotal contracts commence.
full_event_log.Event Title: Revenue surge and ARR target achievement

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave's revenue is expected to grow from $5.1 billion at the end of 2025 to nearly $25 billion by the end of 2027, representing a doubling of revenue in 2026 and 2027 according to Wall Street projections.
full_event_log.Event Title: Revenue projected to reach $25 billion by end of 2027

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave is projected to have 3.1GW of compute capacity online by the end of 2027, representing an incremental $20B ARR over the next period.
full_event_log.Event Title: 3.1GW of compute capacity coming online by end of 2027

full_event_log.Description: CoreWeave, a US cloud computing specialist, and Scottish operator DataVita are leading development of a Scottish data centre with a scheduled completion date of 2030. An investigation by The Guardian has cast serious doubt on whether the project will meet this deadline.
full_event_log.Event Title: Scottish Data Centre Scheduled Completion Under Investigation
